question: What does the original P2 carrier actually supply for the source-neutral partner, and which charge, state and time identifications remain distinct?
summary_de: Konkrete Paarwirkung epsilon1 epsilon4 im originalen Traeger: Hyperladung 1/6, nur unter dem spaeteren Quell-U1 neutral. Exakte transportierte Zeit spaltet das (3,2)-Multiplet. Die vorhandene Cross-Sheet-Ladungskonjugation ist explizit realisiert; sie paart Traegerlabels und erzeugt keinen zweiten physischen Vakuumzustand.
summary_en: The original carrier pair operator has hypercharge 1/6 and is neutral only under the later transported source U1. The exact folded time splits its (3,2) multiplet. Existing cross-sheet charge conjugation is constructed explicitly; it pairs carrier labels, not two physical vacua.
scope: Original finite carrier representation and stipulated E8 fold, with all field/state/time identifications kept separate.
assumptions: Original five-slot 3+2 Hermitian oriented carrier representation and its stated hypercharges.
For the affine spectrum only: the existing E8 Weyl dictionary and fixed quarter K_alpha.
For the sixfold zero-energy implication only: actual common Hilbert space, full connected fixed unbroken S(U3 x U2) action commuting with H, and a distinct invariant vacuum.
positive_results: Exact pair operator, charge actions and general dGamma(h) commutator.
Exact M delta and six root-current energies for both quarter phases.
Explicit cross-sheet antiunitary J_C and its charge/time identities; existing pairing theorem reused.
Only one hypercharge-zero label on each sheet; exterior unit is not an affine vacuum.
On the existing chiral representative, particle-hole conjugation exchanges actual quarter domains, reverses charge and preserves positive excitation time; it adds no same-sector vacuum.
not_derived: Identification of original geometric or OS seam reflection with carrier J_C.
Actual P1 source-to-field map, state or physical time.
A full P1/P2 countermodel or impossibility theorem.
Physical origin, event law or T1-T8 closure.
leaves_open: Derive actual induced boundary conjugation, charge/holonomy and positive transfer on one common field domain/state.
